Cybersecurity.

I am drawn to the craft of making digital spaces trustworthy, resilient, and easier for people to use safely.

security system04

Why it is a future focus.

Security asks a question I care about: how can technology protect people without making their experience harder? It combines careful thinking, curiosity, and responsibility.

I am building my foundation in web development first, then want to explore secure systems, ethical testing, and the decisions that make a product safer from the start.
